_note: Two lists, and the difference between them is the whole file. `order` is THE COURSE: what NEW JOURNEY plays through, in order, each one loading the next when you reach its flag. `also_listed` is everything else the in-game level list offers. LOAD GAME shows both, the course first — so every level that ships can be picked, and only the course chains. A level file owns its own title and copy, so nothing is duplicated here.
_order_note: A new journey opens on First Steps, carries on into The Fractured Isles, climbs The Spire and ends at The Dragon's Roost. First Steps used to be off the course on the grounds that a new game should not open on a greybox - it is not a greybox any more. It is the same coast as the Isles, five short stretches long, and every one of them teaches something the Isles then asks for, which is the right way into the game rather than a detour from it. The Roost is the other end of the same thought: one arena and one flying boss, which asks for the jump, the strike and the blast at once and gives no credit for any of them alone.
_the_spire_note:
ON the course, between the Isles and the Roost, by the author's call on 2026-09-20. It was off it before, and the argument for that is worth keeping because it is still true of the level: The Spire is a climb with no floor under it, it kills on any fall, and it is the only level in the game with no way back - the view ratchets upward and never returns. Dropped between two coast levels it is a change of genre rather than the next chapter.

What it buys is the thing the course did not have: one hard, short, purely mechanical test between the last ordinary level and the final boss. Everything before it is a coast you walk along fighting; the Roost is one arena and one dragon. Eighteen jumps with the sea under them is a reasonable last word on the jump before a boss fight that is largely about where you are standing. It is also the shortest level on the course by a distance, so a player who bounces off it loses minutes, not an evening.
_also_listed_note: Levels shown in the list but NOT part of the course: picking one plays it and finishing it goes nowhere, because nothing follows it. Empty now that Proving Ground has been removed, so the level list is exactly the course. The mechanism stays — add an id here to make a level selectable without putting it on the course, and the menu shows `order` followed by whatever is in here that is not already in it.
_unlisted_note: levels/greybox.json is in neither, on purpose. It is the test fixture — see the why_note in that file — and it is flagged `"listed": false` as well, so it stays out of the list however it is reached.
